scope.note: All styles in this realm are original invented visual systems, so no canonical historical source exists. Each should receive a purpose-built image rather than a literal keyword-search photograph.

audit_method.visual_review: Every current asset was reviewed in three 4-by-4 contact sheets at original sheet resolution.
audit_method.generation_format: Landscape 3:2 gallery thumbnail; subject-neutral visual specimen; edge-to-edge artwork; no border, caption, text, lettering, logo, or watermark.
